title: Jeff Yan's Plan to Bring the Entire Financial Industry Onto Hyperliquid
title_cn: Jeff Yan's Plan to Bring the Entire Financial Industry Onto Hyperliquid
summary: Traders and market watchers around the world started talking about a crypto platform called Hyperliquid earlier this year, when speculators used markets built on top of it to trade crude oil after war broke out in Iran. What Hyperliquid allowed for was a 24/7 market on the blockchain. In August, President Trump said the CFTC was working on bringing “Hyperliquid into the United States in a fully compliant and legal fashion.” Hyperliquid currently operates outside the US, but that hasn't stopped it from growing prodigiously in the last year. Jeff Yan, CEO and co-founder of Hyperliquid Labs, joins us today to explain how exactly the platform works, the protocol he and his co-founders built, the ecology of actors and assets that are tied to Hyperliquid (like the platform's cryptocurrency HYPE), how perps are bought and sold on the platform, what a blockchain oracle is, and what has to happen for Hyperliquid to start operating in the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
